mirrors.before: Fix $M\ge1$ collocation nodes and a nonnegative integer $k$ independent of $h$. Use the explicit-left-Euler SDC sweep in [[alg-explicit-left-euler-sdc-sweep]] with constant predictor $U^0=\mathbf1u$ and form the candidate endpoint from $U^k$, after $k$ completed sweeps. Assume each coordinate of $f$ has continuous partial derivatives through total order $M$ on an open neighborhood of a common compact tube $\mathcal T$; assume $f$ is state-Lipschitz with constant $L$ and bounded by $B$ on $\mathcal T$, which contains the exact path, all iterates, and the comparison segments. Also assume the exact-path integrand has the derivative bound required by [[thm-collocation-local-defect-order-m]]. At each mesh time $t_n$, let $\mathcal U_n\subseteq\mathcal T_{t_n}:=\{u:(t_n,u)\in\mathcal T\}$ be a set of starting states containing the exact and numerical grid states used in the global-error comparison. For every $u\in\mathcal U_n$, assume the constant predictor $U^0=\mathbf1u$ belongs to a nonempty closed product ball $\mathcal C_{n,u}$ used in [[thm-sdc-sweep-contraction-and-error-bound]], and each inner stage map and sweep preserves $\mathcal C_{n,u}$. Assume the contraction theorem holds uniformly with $a=hL\|Q_\Delta\|_\infty\le1/2$ and $q\le C_qh<1$. For fixed $k$, the $U^k$ endpoint map has exact-start defect $O(h^{p+1})$ and global order $p=\min(M,k+1)$ on any fixed interval, provided all grid states stay in $\mathcal T$. The claim is local-step and fixed-$k$; it asserts no uniform constants as $M$ or $k$ grows.

mirrors.before: Let the common state tube be $[0,2e]$ and take the time-fiber start sets $\mathcal U_n=[1,e]$; the field $f(t,y)=y$ is bounded there by $B=2e$ and is $1$-Lipschitz. For every start $u\in\mathcal U_n$, use the one-stage closed product ball $\mathcal C_u=[0,2u]$, which contains the constant predictor $U^0=u$. By [F12], for $V\in\mathcal C_u$ the inner/outer sweep map is $S_u(V)=u+(h/2)V$, whose values lie in $[u,u+hu]\subseteq[u,2u]\subseteq\mathcal C_u$ when $0<h\le1$. The contraction constants are $a=0$ and $q=h/2\le1/2$, with $q=(1/2)h$. Thus [F13] supplies the unique local collocation branch in $\mathcal C_u$, uniformly for the start states used in the stability comparison. Now induct on the mesh index. If all earlier checks passed, then $y_n=(1+h)^n>0$; for $nh\le1$, [F6] gives $(1+h)^n\le\exp(nh)$ and [F11] gives $\exp(nh)\le e$, so $y_n\in\mathcal U_n$ and the stage set hypotheses just verified apply. The first sweep value is $U^1=y_n+(h/2)y_n$, with update residual $r_0=h|y_n|/2\le eh/2$. For sufficiently small $h$, $eh/2\le1-h/2=(1-q)\mathrm{tol}$, so [F1] returns $U^0$ after the first check and the endpoint is $y_{n+1}=(1+h)y_n$. This closes the induction for every step.
